content.name: Rod of Alertness
entries: This rod has a flanged head and the following properties.

entries.name: Alertness
entries: While holding the rod, you have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks and on rolls for initiative.

entries.name: Spells
entries: While holding the rod, you can use an action to cast one of the following spells from it: {@spell detect evil and good}, {@spell detect magic}, {@spell detect poison and disease}, or {@spell see invisibility}.

entries.name: Protective Aura
entries: As an action, you can plant the haft end of the rod in the ground, whereupon the rod's head sheds bright light in a 60-foot radius and dim light for an additional 60 feet. While in that bright light, you and any creature that is friendly to you gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws and can sense the location of any {@condition invisible} hostile creature that is also in the bright light.
The rod's head stops glowing and the effect ends after 10 minutes, or when a creature uses an action to pull the rod from the ground. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.

entries.name: Alertness
entries: While holding the rod, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|SRD52}) checks and on {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} rolls.

entries.name: Spells

entries.name: Protective Aura
entries: As a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, you can plant the haft end of the rod in the ground, whereupon the rod's head sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 60-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 60 feet. While in that {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52}, you and your allies gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52} and saving throws and can sense the location of any {@condition Invisible|SRD52} creature that is also in the {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52}.

The rod's head stops glowing and the effect ends after 10 minutes or when a creature takes a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to pull the rod from the ground. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.
